'''They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping''' (Japanese: '''ハリマロン、刺す''' ''{{tt|Harimaron|Chespin}}, Pierce'') is the 552nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the fourth chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|X}} attempts to have [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] [[Mega Evolution|transform]], but fails.
* Left with no other choice, X teams up with [[Marisso|Chespin]] and defeats [[Aliana]] and [[Mable]].
* X and {{adv|Y}} both receive [[Pokédex]]es.
* The group escapes and goes to camp out in [[Santalune Forest]] for the night.
* {{adv|Trevor}} discovers [[Mega Stone|a strange stone]] in Kanga's pouch.
* [[Professor Sycamore]] shows [[Lysandre]] the footage of the [[Vaniville Town]] incident.
